messages:
lina (solutions): Quick follow-up from today's AH Q&A — heard multiple asks about why we lost two mid-market pilots. Can leadership summarize the top themes so we can update playbooks?

sam (ceo): Top-line: speed-to-pilot and confidence in perf under load. Customers wanted a straight path from signed PO -> production pilot in <3 weeks.

rebecca (cs): To be specific: they asked for a named technical lead during onboarding, an official audit pack (SOC2/KMS docs), and clearer guidance on quantization impacts. Those 3 were brought up repeatedly.

anya (product): Actionable items I hear: 1) pilot onboarding checklist + named-POC SLA, 2) compact audit bundle for sales, 3) a short doc on quantization and quality tradeoffs for common models. Agree?

lina (solutions): Yep. Also include an example timeline we can share — what we will deliver week-by-week during a pilot. Sales needs that to set expectations.

omar (eng-sre): For performance confidence we can add a 'pilot perf run' template (load test script + perf dashboard) that customers can run with our guidance. I can mock a perf-qa job in k8s and share the script. ETA 5 days.

rebecca (cs): CS will own the named-POC process and the onboarding checklist. I'll draft the PO email template and the POC responsibilities doc.

anya (product): Product will create the short quantization impact guide (2 pages) and a 'how we measure latency' FAQ. Target: 2 sprints for MVP.

sam (ceo): Good. Lina / Sales: please compile a prioritized list of pilot customers who asked for this so we can kick off pilot improvements in a targeted way.

lina (solutions): Will do — I'll post the list in #sales-results by EOD.

ops-bot: Calendar invite: "Pilot playbook sync" Thu 10:00 — attendees: Anya, Sam, Lina, Omar, Rebecca.

rebecca (cs): After the sync I'll upload the checklist to the playbooks folder and tag #customer-success.

anya (product): One more ask from the AH: can we surface a short "why customers choose Redwood" blurb for Sales — 3 bullets on reliability, observability, and predictable TCO? Julia usually likes that.

sam (ceo): Yes — make it product-facing and keep it <3 bullets, each 8-12 words. Product owns this copy.

lina (solutions): Thanks everyone. This feels actionable. We'll use the sync to assign owners and timelines.

ops-bot: Thread closed by ops-bot.
_meta: generated for dataset: all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses and feedback loops
